title: Zoomin Moved to Oracle Cloud to Support Their SaaS Platform
description: Zoomin, an alum of Startup Cloud Accelerator, personalizes the way users interact with technical product content through their SaaS platform. They moved to Oracle Cloud to support mission critical cloud applications for their customers.

asr.full_text: The Oracle Global Startup Program allows companies like ours. Build a work plan of how to penetrate enterprise companies. In general, and more specifically,. How to work with a company like Oracle, where are the synergies,. And what's the work plan moving forward. Zoomin is a SaaS platform for personalization. Of technical product content. So what we essentially do, we personalize the way users. Interact with manuals, guides, training materials, technology. APIs, knowledge-based articles, and community discussions. Before Oracle, we've used the other cloud provider. Like Amazon and like Microsoft. And we're now very heavily using Oracle. As a cloud provider for our technology. The main benefits of using the Oracle Cloud for us. Are the robustness of the cloud infrastructure,. The fact that it's enterprise-grade,. Supports security, and many issues that. Are important for us as a company that. Provides mission-critical cloud applications for our customers.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a corporate interview about Zoomin's SaaS product and its relationship with Oracle's startup and cloud programs. The discussion concerns infrastructure, enterprise support, and security for the technology and its customers, which is ordinary business promotion. The closing “Learn More” prompt and Oracle startup URL are not connected in the described material to payment requests, credential collection, deceptive return promises, or a reported transaction.
